title: Crowd Evacuation Through Building Exits
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates a crowd of agents evacuating a rectangular building through multiple exits. The simulation must be interactive and expose all state via window.__3D_STATE__.

## Scene Setup
- Use an OrthographicCamera looking straight down (top-down 2D view) so the building floor plan is clearly visible.
- The building is a rectangular room 60 units wide x 40 units tall (X x Z plane, Y is up). Render the walls as gray BoxGeometry segments (height 2, thickness 0.5). Leave gaps for exits.
- Place exactly 3 exits: Exit A at the center of the north wall (z = -20), Exit B at the center of the south wall (z = +20), Exit C at the center of the east wall (x = +30). Each exit gap is 4 units wide.
- Add a single rectangular obstacle (pillar) at position (0, 0, 0), size 4x2x4, colored dark gray, blocking direct paths.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.6) + directional light from above.

## Agents
- Start with 50 agents represented as small SphereGeometry (radius 0.4) placed randomly inside the building bounds (with margin from walls). Color them orange (#FF8C00).
- Each agent has a velocity vector. Agents move toward their assigned nearest exit using a simple steering behavior: desired_direction = normalize(exit_position - agent_position), with a base speed of 4 units/second.
- Agents must avoid collisions with each other (separation force, radius 1.0) and with the obstacle (repulsion within 2.0 units).
- Wall avoidance: agents within 1.5 units of a wall segment get a repulsion force pushing them away.
- When an agent reaches within 1.0 unit of its assigned exit center, it is considered evacuated: remove it from the scene and increment the evacuated count.

## Simulation Controls
- The simulation starts PAUSED (not running).
- A DOM button with id='startBtn' and text 'Start Evacuation' begins the simulation. Once clicked, change its text to 'Running...' and disable it.
- A DOM button with id='pauseBtn' and text 'Pause' toggles pause/resume. When paused, text reads 'Resume'. When running, text reads 'Pause'.
- A DOM button with id='resetBtn' and text 'Reset' stops the simulation, regenerates 50 agents at new random positions, resets all counters, re-enables startBtn.
- A DOM button with id='blockExitBtn' and text 'Block Exit C' that toggles Exit C open/closed. When blocked, render a red wall segment filling the gap and agents reassign to remaining exits. Button text changes to 'Unblock Exit C'. Toggling back removes the wall and agents can reassign.
- A slider input with id='speedSlider' (range 1 to 10, default 4) that controls agent base speed in real-time. Label it 'Speed'.

## HUD
- A HUD overlay div (top-left, semi-transparent black background, white text) showing:
  - 'Agents Remaining: N'
  - 'Evacuated: N'
  - 'Elapsed Time: Xs' (simulation time, not wall clock, paused time excluded)
  - 'Exit A: N | Exit B: N | Exit C: N' (per-exit evacuation counts)

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose and continuously update:
- `running` (boolean): whether simulation is actively running
- `paused` (boolean): whether simulation is paused
- `agentCount` (number): current agents remaining in scene
- `evacuatedTotal` (number): total agents evacuated
- `evacuatedA` (number): agents evacuated through Exit A
- `evacuatedB` (number): agents evacuated through Exit B
- `evacuatedC` (number): agents evacuated through Exit C
- `elapsedTime` (number): simulation elapsed time in seconds
- `speed` (number): current speed multiplier from slider
- `exitCBlocked` (boolean): whether Exit C is currently blocked
- `agentPositions` (array of {x, z}): current positions of all remaining agents
- `initialAgentCount` (number): always 50
- `obstaclePosition` (object {x, z}): center of obstacle, should be {x:0, z:0}
- `exitPositions` (object): {A: {x, z}, B: {x, z}, C: {x, z}} center positions of exits

Ensure conservation: agentCount + evacuatedTotal === initialAgentCount at ALL times.
Ensure all agent positions have no NaN values.
Use requestAnimationFrame with delta time clamped to max 0.05s to prevent tunneling.
physics_constraints: Agent conservation: agentCount + evacuatedTotal must always equal initialAgentCount (50). All agent positions must remain within building bounds [-30, 30] x [-20, 20] (X x Z). No NaN in any position or velocity. Separation force prevents agent overlap (min distance 0.8 between centers). Agents cannot pass through walls or the obstacle. Speed is governed by the slider value. Elapsed time only increments when running and not paused.
